vulnerability.explanation: memcmp() is called with a fixed length of 8 on sp->otherSettings.jpegtables without verifying the actual size of the JPEGTables buffer. If an application supplies a JPEGTables value shorter than 8 bytes, this compares past the end of the buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read.
